interpretation: First PC explains 50 percent of paradigm variance with all pairwise correlations positive (a positive manifold, r=0.99 with mean accuracy). The raw within-minus-cross gap is small and non-significant (delta=0.055, one-sided p=0.11). After removing the general factor by row-mean residualization the within-grouping contrast is suggestive but reaches only one-sided significance (delta=0.148, one-sided p=0.04, two-sided p=0.06).
